title: MARBLE: Reinforcement Learning Framework for Multi-Aspect Diffusion Alignment
summary: MARBLE is a reinforcement learning framework designed to fine-tune diffusion models by balancing multiple quality criteria simultaneously. It replaces manual reward weighting with gradient-space harmonization to improve aesthetics, text alignment, and safety in a single training run.
research_notes: Built upon DiffusionNFT; uses the Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) to harmonize conflicting reward gradients.

evolution.summary: Currently expanding from static image diffusion fine-tuning to video generation models; releasing full training code and multi-node scripts.
